description: This Kotlin source file defines a MockRepository class that provides local data and simple persistence functions for a fitness app. It includes sample workout data, badge data, profile management, and workout filtering logic based on user preferences.

classes.name: MockRepository
classes.description: A repository class that provides mock data for workouts, badges, profile management, and filtering logic for a fitness application.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Returns the current user profile, with default values if not set.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates and saves the user profile data in shared preferences.

methods.name: updateGoal
methods.description: Updates and saves the user's fitness goals.

methods.name: getDailyOrContinue
methods.description: Filters workouts to include only those categorized as 'Daily' or 'Continue'.

methods.name: getRecommended
methods.description: Provides a list of recommended workouts based on user profile, preferences, and intensity bias.

methods.name: getBadges
methods.description: Returns a list of the available badges.

methods.name: getWorkouts
methods.description: Returns the list of all available workouts.

methods.name: searchWorkouts
methods.description: Searches workouts by query matching title, category, or intensity.

methods.name: recentProgress
methods.description: Generates mock recent progress data for the past 7 days.
